sections.value: Final #311 review at 5e03e02 is PASS WITH NOTES (e6858c8); the PR merged after publication. The three R1 fake-only probes now pass: pre-subscription lapse queues one restart, overwritten lapse queues one, and pre-handling renewal queues none. Warm initial reconciliation before an overflow probe, otherwise boot catch-up can hide a broken gap path. Six independent probes also covered a live positive control, overlapping consumers sharing one acting decision, and abort/join with pending liveness and an overflowed ring. Seven new guard mutants were killed, then the restored recovery baseline passed 22/22. Full local Rust, smoke, route, native, SDK and skill gates passed; C25 dependency-limited checks did not. New nonblocking R311-C34-01 qualifies gap-storm cost: outstanding is three indexed SELECTs in one transaction, with no separate reconcile-rate cap. Post-deploy cost receipts remain performance/deploy-owned.
